title: Jallikattu Kaalai
desc: Gopalkrishnan, an ordinary mill worker, falls in love with the mill owner's daughter. However, a vicious landlord causes a stir in their lives.

title: Bheeshmar
desc: Framed and jailed, honest cop Bheeshmar considers revenge after his wife dies, but ultimately decides to start anew with his child instead of seeking payback.

title: Mechanic Mapillai
desc: After losing his job, Ravi becomes a mechanic and falls for his boss's daughter. However, conflict arises when the owner discovers that Ravi is the son of his sworn enemy.

title: Chinna Jameen
desc: Rasaiya, a wealthy yet naive man, is raised by his abusive uncle, who covets his property. However, when his uncle kills Rasaiya's lover Jothi, he resolves to avenge her death.
